findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "oddsockets_signup" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Create a new OddSockets app and start the 7-day free trial (card required, cancel anytime before day 7). Requires the human's email: the trial + activation link…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
